findings.title: Pass a user record when deleting through the association
findings.body: `group.users.delete` expects associated user records, but this passes the integer `user_id`. Active Record can reject the integer as the wrong association type, causing the remove-member request to fail instead of removing the membership. Load the user or delete the matching association row by ID.

findings.title: Group creation ignores the selected alias level
findings.body: The admin form sends `alias_level` when creating a group, but this action only assigns `name` and `visible` before saving. A newly created group therefore keeps the model default alias level regardless of the value selected in the form.

findings.title: Public group member pages now return only the first 50 members
findings.body: This endpoint now applies a default limit of 50 to every group, whereas non-automatic groups previously returned all members. The public group-members route has no pagination UI, so groups with more than 50 members silently omit the rest from the page.

findings.title: Exact page-size multiples produce an extra empty page
findings.body: Using `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` overcounts pages when the member count is an exact multiple of the limit. For example, 50 members at a limit of 50 reports two pages, enabling Next to navigate to an empty page.
